sentences: I set the camera to aperture priority mode and select f/8 for this landscape shot.
I check the histogram after each exposure to ensure the highlights are not clipped.
I attach the 24-70mm lens to the body and twist it until it clicks into place.
I mount the camera on the tripod and tighten the ball head to prevent any movement.
I format the memory card in the camera before starting a new session.
I adjust the ISO to 400 because the light is diminishing as the sun sets.
I switch the focus mode to single-servo AF and place the active point on the subject's eye.
I set the white balance to daylight and shoot a test frame to check the color.
I pack two spare batteries and a charger in the side pocket of my camera bag.
I clean the front element of the lens with a microfiber cloth and a few drops of solution.
I review the images on the LCD and delete the ones where the focus missed.
I export the raw files to TIFF format and open them in the editing software.
I crop the frame to remove the distracting branch on the left edge.
I set the self-timer to two seconds to avoid shaking the camera when pressing the shutter.
I bracket three exposures at one-stop intervals to capture the full dynamic range.
I use a polarizing filter to reduce the glare on the surface of the water.
I check the camera's level indicator and adjust the tripod legs until the bubble is centered.
I upload the final JPEGs to the client's online gallery and send them the link.
I record the location and time in the metadata field for each photograph.
I back up the day's shoot to an external drive and a cloud folder.
